description: This file defines a PHP class 'Image_Graph_Marker_Icon' that extends 'Image_Graph_Marker'. It represents a marker that uses an image icon for rendering in a graph. The class includes methods for setting the icon's filename, positioning, and rendering the marker on a canvas.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Marker_Icon
classes.description: A marker class that renders an image icon at specified coordinates on a graph canvas.

methods.name: Image_Graph_Marker_Icon
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the icon marker with a filename and optional size.

methods.name: setPointX
methods.description: Sets the X coordinate for the icon's center point.

methods.name: setPointY
methods.description: Sets the Y coordinate for the icon's center point.

methods.name: _drawMarker
methods.description: Handles drawing the icon marker on the canvas at specified coordinates.
